Document 3 (D3S2) and Document 4 (D4S1/D4S2) explicitly state he was a 'forward', with D4S2 noting the context was modified to reflect this. Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and treat audit labels/saved answers as fallible, both 'defender' and 'forward' are retained as valid answers derived directly from the source text, despite the contradiction.
